features.quote: We cut the loop after `stuck_repeat_threshold` (default 6) identical signatures
features.justification_quote: A model thrashing on the exact same action, or repeating the same paragraph, is both a stability signal and a cost sink

features.quote: providing a `give_up` tool... lets the agent express defeat cleanly
